title: Google Cloud
prompt: Configure the documented Google Cloud provider using the Vertex-related SDK settings; verify credentials, model identifiers, and feature availability.
scope: Validate provider configuration diagnostics locally; use actual cloud inference and account identity for live access verification.

modes.label: Local provider diagnostics
modes.description: Actual SDK operations with zero model turns. This does not certify the live model scenario.

modes.label: Live model scenario
modes.description: Actual model calls with bounded turns, cost and time. Requires locally configured replacement credentials and uses account credits.
